sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
B.M. SHYAM PRASAD, J., DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

On 30.05.2023 a final opportunity was granted to comply with the office objections observing that if there is failure to comply with the office objections, the appeal must be listed for necessary orders on dismissal.
Despite this final opportunity, the office objections have not been attended to, and none appears for the appellant.

It is obvious that the concerned are not interested in prosecuting the appeal and therefore the appeal stands dismissed for default.
Sd/-
JUDGE Sd/-
